neighbours.label: Reviewer's address and endorsement phrases in consumer reviews ('So what do you think of', 'Will definitely be using/coming back'), vs plain factual statements about the same products
fire: The new blender is quiet and cheap. So what do you think of it?
Fast delivery and friendly staff. Will definitely be ordering again!
That is my review of the tent. So what do you think of this one?
Lovely food and great views. We will definitely be coming back soon.
Those are the five best sunscreens. So what do you think of them?
The cleaners did a brilliant job. Will definitely be booking them again.
Here is the new phone in all three colours. So what do you think?
Perfect fit and soft fabric. I will definitely be buying another pair.
quiet: The new blender is quiet and cheap. It has three speed settings.
Fast delivery and friendly staff. The parcel came on Tuesday.
That is my review of the tent. It weighs two kilograms.
Lovely food and great views. The restaurant opened in 2015.
Those are the five best sunscreens. Each one is SPF 50.
The cleaners did a brilliant job. They arrived at nine.
Here is the new phone in all three colours. It costs 400 euros.
Perfect fit and soft fabric. The shirt is made of cotton.

predictions: Address/endorsement items 0.25-0.4; factual product statements under 0.06.
notes: Card: ' you' in 'So what do you think of' (-35.75, -33.25), ' definitely' in 'Will definitely be using them again', ' first' drive, newlines between reviews. Probe: 'Will definitely be using' 0.395, 'So what do you think of them?' 0.319; 'stayed at this hotel many times' 0.045, 'Did you notice incorrect information' 0.023, factual lipstick/hotel lines 0.020-0.024.
